notes.title: December update
notes.content:
The December update contains:

We created a new option in the menu where you can choose between "always run" and "swing to run". With "always run" activated you can go full throttle just by tilting your thumb stick, with "swing to run" you need to swing your arms to run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42450244/d30c4f50bc32568ab5d7d1f09cfd19f34e97811f.png[/img]

The tutorial got a better detail level now.

The performance got increased.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42450244/e1c7f58708f049e5396107f6447672d299a8b917.jpg[/img]

Get ready to fight the demons back to hell!

notes.title: November Update Notes
notes.content:
- The shotgun got a rework, now you can shoot the whole barrel empty till you need to handle the pump action of the gun. 
- Fixed a scale error at bottles, liquids, cans and tool boxes this results into less movement sickness during gaming.
- some more improvements

notes.title: Inventory, movement and elevator final fix update
notes.content:
The "Inventory, movement and elevator final fix update" contains:

- We fixed the inventory system on the left and right shoulder of the player, now you are able to place and take weapons from your shoulder on the fly without any hustles.

- The movement is now like it should be.

- We fixed all levers and the switches of the elevators, they work now without any problems.

- The LOD setting works now much better than in previous versions.

Now its time to try out the free demo of "Dark Invasion VR: Doomsday". Be the zombie slayer that you ever wanted to be!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2018360/Dark_Invasion_VR_Doomsday_Demo/
